sharedRequirements.text:
All six retain actual Cleric/Druid/Mage/Wizard Abjuration rank9, minimum class level17, base26RP. Reality Anchor's Transmutation placement grants no additional repertoire route. An actor must have an actual legal acquisition/preparation, sufficient current resources, usable voice/somatic hand and actual class focus or a source-supplied material alternative. Eternal/Ultimate retain V/S/M-or-F; the other four retain V/S/F. No costly/consumed material is invented. Actual class ability/PB and acquired bonuses supply attacks/DCs. A supplied finite player-character fixture proves only its declared choices, not campaign possession.

Determine legality and pre-cast price first; then spend actual Action, RP, components and concentration transition before cast-time counters and hidden outcomes. First distinct prepared Wizard family waives BASE strain only, not Refrain: rank9 base strain2, consecutive same-name Refrain increments through3, different name resets that consecutive count but not used-family history. Dissonance price uses the pre-cast value. All failure/counter/suppression results retain payment/cadence and displaced concentration. No generic upcast, free cast, resource proc or second counter window follows a reflected branch, suppression resumption or component cleanup. Readying an Action spell uses the existing paid preparation/concentration/Reaction-release contract, expiry before next own regular start; ten-minute Eternal Ward cannot be generically Readied.

Each application records castId, original caster/class/school/rank, paid resource history, actual geometry and recipients, establishment timestamp, original absolute deadline or explicit source-relative clock, source concentration owner, independently removed components and consumed event IDs. Half-open absolute lifetimes exclude the deadline. Regular actor starts/ends are independent of spell events: refresh Reaction/budgets, tick recharge, expire Ready, perform actual required death saves and due effects in accepted order. No pulse, load, extra Action or menu grants a turn. No invented die outcomes: finite declared rolls are authored test inputs, never observations. A missing required outcome leaves that transition held.

KEEP Action,100ft,V/S/F,base26 and BOTH native placements. NEW choose one mode before payment through actual ordinary Abjuration access: Permission mode resolves the Abjuration promise that magic functions only as you permit; Transmutation mode resolves the separate placement's nullification of ALL Transmutation. No extra class-school acquisition is granted; active source placement is recorded for classification. NEW both use a fixed perceived center within100ft/line of effect,100ft-radius sphere clipped by actual solid total cover and concentration for60elapsed seconds. This expressly supplies the missing maintained lifetime for the instantaneous permission placement. Neither follows the caster.

NEW Permission mode is a finite predeclared allowlist/denylist over actual source IDs, continuous caster identities already personally identified, exact application IDs already identified, and actual generating-school labels. Declare default ALLOW or DENY and ordered rules before commitment; first matching rule wins, otherwise default. No wild-card hidden faction/alignment/HP oracle, remote inventory scan or retroactive choice. The real source resolver can privately compare a specified identified handle without revealing new handles. An operative conscious owner with voice/hand/focus, within100ft of center and actually perceiving the sigil may spend one regular Action to replace the complete ordered policy; no new cast/RP/clock reset. Transmutation mode has fixed deny-all actual Transmutation and no whitelist edit. Owner absence outside range leaves the old policy; death/incapacitation/lost concentration ends the field. Unload does neither. Editing is a management operation of the existing field, admitted by its own maintained source even when its own default denies ordinary magic; a genuinely suppressing external source at the owner/management locus can still prevent an edit.

KEEP Action,100ft,V/S/F,base26 and BOTH native placements. NEW choose one mode before payment through actual ordinary Abjuration access: Permission mode resolves the Abjuration promise that magic functions only as you permit; Transmutation mode resolves the separate placement's nullification of ALL Transmutation. No extra class-school acquisition is granted; active source placement is recorded for classification. NEW both use a fixed perceived center within100ft/line of effect,100ft-radius sphere clipped by actual solid total cover and concentration for60elapsed seconds. This expressly supplies the missing maintained lifetime for the instantaneous permission placement. Neither follows the caster.

NEW deny local expression of actual spells and explicitly magical nonspell/item/innate ongoing components under the selected policy. Multi-school identities use the actual selected generating placement/class mode, not a visual theme or the union of inaccessible placements; Reality Anchor's Transmutation mode is labelled Transmutation for this test while access remains Abjuration. Apply accepted Antimagic IO categories expressly for this new spell: inside-origin ordinary magic payload denied; outside-origin magic checked at actual recipient/area/destination; genuinely path-bearing sources use their actual path. An outside-to-outside nonpath teleport does not cross an imaginary segment. Recipient-attached expressions are wholly denied on body intersection, extended fields lose only actual intersections unless indivisible. Remote concentration owner presence does not itself reach a remote outside expression. Permanent completed ordinary matter, RP engines, intrinsic creature/class identity, prior knowledge/injury/costs remain. Forms/summons/items retain exact source body/gear/HP/slot/deadline; unavailable profiles are narrow holds. Permission admits an otherwise eligible expression only; it never grants access or defeats another live denial.

NEW independent operative Anchors combine denial: if any applicable field denies an expression, it is denied. Already-established Anchor field maintenance/field expression is exempt from OTHER Anchor permissions and Transmutation denial solely to avoid mutual oscillation; ordinary payloads and new Anchor creation have NO such exemption. A new cast originating/capturing a denied creation locus fails paid and cannot bootstrap its own permissive policy. Fields may be established outside each other then have real overlapping volumes. Established fields continue with independent original clocks; an owner edit does not delete its neighbor. External Lesser/Rank8 Antimagic is not part of the exemption: it suppresses actual overlapping Anchor expression/termination operations under its exact IO, never a remote outside field merely from owner proximity. Removing one source re-evaluates current expressions once against the surviving set, with no cast/event replay, missed pulse or regenerated removed component.

NEW permission denial can suppress local Eternal functions, Ultimate/Greater recipient wards and Prismatic layers by their actual source IDs/school/manifestations; full original records persist. Nullification Wave still pays and snapshots creation/payload denial before endings, with no retroactive admission after deleting a denier. Wave/real dispel may select an Anchor as independently addressed source; ignore only its own denial for its own termination, while other real deniers remain. This named self-termination convention is local to Anchor, not immunity for arbitrary dispels. All independent suppression/deadline/custody predicates remain finite and ordered.

Select the finite named source-pair decisions in SOURCE_PAIR_TABLE.json. Ordinary Spell Turning, Prismatic Wall and Greater Dispel are now exact accepted comparisons; historical pending labels are not authority. Actual class Dispel remains rank3/cost3. All named working examples and missing-profile holds are linked below.

spellLocalChoices.access: Preserve the same four native Abjuration routes, rank 9, minimum level 17, base 26 RP. The Transmutation placement grants no additional acquisition route.
spellLocalChoices.activation: Action; V/S/F; select mode before payment.
spellLocalChoices.editing: Conscious operative owner, within 100 feet of the perceived sigil, with usable components, spends an Action to replace the policy. No new cast, RP payment or duration reset. Transmutation mode has no whitelist edit.
spellLocalChoices.effect: Suppress denied expressions; retain original sources, costs, deadlines, pools, gear and history. Prevented new applications have nothing to resume. No replay of missed casts, commands or pulses.
spellLocalChoices.ending: Loss of concentration ends the field. Owner departure alone retains the policy; unloading does not reset it. Actual termination remains independently addressable under the selected source-pair rule.
spellLocalChoices.geometryAndDuration: Fixed perceived center within 100 feet, 100-foot radius clipped by solid total cover; concentration for 60 elapsed seconds. This completes the Abjuration placement's unresolved maintained lifetime despite its printed Instantaneous entry.
spellLocalChoices.overlap: Any independently operative denial remains effective. Already-established Anchor maintenance alone receives the selected same-family exemption; new Anchor creation cannot bootstrap that exemption. External antimagic retains its actual scope.
spellLocalChoices.permissionGrammar: Predeclared default ALLOW/DENY plus ordered rules for known source IDs, personally identified caster identities, identified application IDs or actual generating schools. First matching rule wins. No hidden-identity or inventory oracle.
spellLocalChoices.placements: Preserve Permission mode (magic functions only as permitted) and Transmutation mode (nullify all actual Transmutation expressions). Neither placement replaces the other.
